overview.description: China AI ETF is an exchange-traded fund that provides targeted exposure to Chinese companies involved in the development and application of artificial intelligence technologies. The fund invests in companies across areas such as AI software, semiconductors, cloud computing, data infrastructure, robotics, and other technologies supporting the growth of China’s artificial intelligence industry.
